title: Grove's Allocation System Primitive is instantiated as a named product, the Grove Liquidity Layer
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.1 contains a small but revealing slip of vocabulary. Every other Primitive Hub Document in the Grove Artifact says it organizes information relevant to "Grove's usage of the [X] Primitive." This one says it organizes "all base information relevant to **Grove's usage of the Grove Liquidity Layer**."

The substitution shows where the abstraction meets the product. The Allocation System Primitive is Sky's generic mechanism for an Agent to deploy stablecoin liquidity into yield-bearing positions; the **Grove Liquidity Layer** is Grove's concrete implementation of it, and in Grove's own document the two names are used interchangeably.

This matters for reading the rest of the Artifact. The Allocation System Primitive is where Grove's actual business lives — it is the Supply Side Stablecoin Primitive (A.6.1.1.2.2.6) whose Active Instances are the individual credit and RWA positions. It is also the exact Primitive singled out by A.6.1.1.2.2.2.2.2.1.2.4 as requiring Core Council Risk Advisor approval for risk-increasing changes.

So the Primitive that carries Grove's strategy is simultaneously the Primitive under the tightest external supervision. Grove's autonomy is broadest in the areas that matter least to Sky's balance sheet and narrowest in the one that defines the Agent.
description: The Primitive Hub Document describes itself as covering 'Grove's usage of the Grove Liquidity Layer', collapsing the abstract Sky Primitive and Grove's actual credit product into one node.
